subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu add a supported inbound attachment-context opt-out, and what canonical config name, default, and account inheritance behavior should it use?
rationale: Honoring the reported key would add a plugin-owned config/default surface that changes model context behavior and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level and per-account option with current media download behavior as the default and placeholder-only behavior when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Create or reuse a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one canonical config shape across plugins.

options.title: Document Unsupported
options.body: Document that Feishu supports `mediaMaxMb` but no attachment-content ignore switch, then close the expectation as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level and per-account option with current media download behavior as the default and placeholder-only behavior when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest recent merged history on Feishu media behavior and docs.
